page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 40 physical cores and 40 vCPUs, operating with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 4.8 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on external network storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is measured at 1438.99, while multi-core performance reaches 38378.07. Memory bandwidth tests show 2133.36 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads, and 48.09 GB/sec for large-block writes. In database and application-level benchmarks, the server achieves 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a PassMark database operations score of 14249.04. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the system processes 135M parameter LLM prompts at 1841.39 tokens per second and generates text at 76.66 tokens per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge offers a stable resource profile for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. The lack of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing users to scale storage independently. This hardware configuration is suitable for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded software compilation, database operations, and static web serving.
